remarks: Move-in ready and completely renovated by the owner/builder for his own family, this beautifully appointed four-bedroom home offers exceptional craftsmanship and effortless modern living. Set on a quiet side street across from a park and playground, the home features a sophisticated open-concept kitchen and living space with sliders to a private, level backyard. The expansive primary suite includes a walk-in closet, generous bath and sitting area. An additional 400 finished sq. ft. in the lower level adds flexible living space. Exceptional curb appeal and an ideal location close to schools, train, shopping, beach and Greenwich Avenue.
